surfaces.name: Payment Settings
surfaces.why_required: Without Etsy Payments onboarding and a deposit account, Etsy has nowhere to send money and in most jurisdictions the shop cannot open.

surfaces.name: Legal and tax information
surfaces.why_required: Etsy requires identity verification before a shop can sell, and the tax position has to be chosen before the first invoice rather than corrected after it.

surfaces.name: Your Shop (storefront)
surfaces.why_required: A storefront with a blank announcement and no digital sale message sells to nobody and tells a buyer nothing after they pay. Both are writable, so leaving them empty would be a choice.

surfaces.name: Info & Appearance
surfaces.why_required: A shop with no icon, no banner and no About reads as abandoned to the only buyer we will ever get -- one with no reviews to reassure them.

surfaces.name: Options
surfaces.why_required: Vacation mode on means no sales at all, and the wrong shop currency makes every price decision in this repository wrong by an exchange rate.

surfaces.name: Policy Settings
surfaces.why_required: A shop whose policy pages are blank is selling a non-returnable digital item with no stated position on returns, which is the single most likely first complaint.

surfaces.name: Digital files
surfaces.why_required: A digital listing with no file sells a buyer nothing, and Etsy delivers whatever is attached without asking us.

surfaces.name: Category & attributes
surfaces.why_required: A listing cannot be created without a taxonomy_id, and a wrong one is a listing in the wrong category -- which Etsy accepts silently, so nothing fails and nobody finds it.
